question.text: Mixing of two different ideal gases under isothermal reversible condition will lead to

options.text: increase of Gibbs free energy of the system
no change of entropy of the system
increase of entropy of the system
increase of enthalpy of the system

solution.text: On mixing of two different ideal gases under isothermal reversible conditions, $\Delta S_{\operatorname{mix}}$ is always positive $i . e .$, increasing.
